description: Values the framework's Go and Java code issued at commit 2360d29, before the token-spelling contract (docs/contracts/token-spelling.md, section 6), regenerated from that commit's own sealing and nonce code in a throwaway worktree on 2026-11-19 (the sealed cookies carry a random IV, so they are new values; the nonces are deterministic and came out identical to the ones first written). A FIXTURE, written once and never regenerated: every implementation must still accept each value, which shows that a value issued before the rule verifies after it (a browser holds its sealed cookie across a deploy). cookieKeys is auth.cookie-keys (a TEST KEY, published on purpose: never configure it anywhere real). sealedCookies: values sealed by the cookie driver (sessions contract 6.5) for 'kind', which open to 'plaintext' (UTF-8); their lengths give each residue mod 4 of the sealed part, so each count of spare bits. fieldNonces: application nonces (15.4) issued at 'now' (Go and Java issue the same nonce for the same key and time).
howToRun: Parse cookieKeys as auth.cookie-keys. Each sealed value opens for its kind to its plaintext; each nonce is valid at its now. Produced by a throwaway test in a detached worktree of 2360d29 (Go go/auth CookieKeys.seal and fieldNonces.issue, Java CookieKeys.seal and FieldNonces.issue), never by the code of this change.
